thread:
Aria: Huge shoutout to Ben and Chen for jumping on the midnight demo rescue — streaming lag was brutal and they nailed a fix fast. Sending virtual cookies :cookie: :tada:
Ben: thanks! Chen spotted the race condition in the batcher. didn't realize it would show up only at high-concurrency.
Chen: yep, race in the request queue pointer. patch went out and perf smoothed right away. also big thanks to Noor for staying on the call. :raised_hands:
Noor: happy to help. the customer call ended up feeling seamless after the patch. nice teamwork.
Aria: Adding to the kudos board: https://kudos.redwood/board — drop a note so people see this tomorrow.
people-ops: Sending a 2x coffee voucher to Ben and Chen for after-hours support. Check your inbox. :coffee:
Ben: omg yesss. coffee = fuel.
Chen: thank you! also will add a quick runbook blurb under "streaming/late-demo":
```
# if you see 503s during high-concurrency streaming
1) check batcher queue size: /var/run/batcher/metrics
2) restart batcher with `systemctl restart redwood-batcher` if queue stuck
3) look for pointer race in logs: grep "queue-pointer" /var/log/streaming.log
```
Aria: Perfect. @ops-bot can you create a follow-up to document the fix and assign to Chen?
ops-bot: Created ticket: "document-streaming-batcher-race" assigned to Chen, due in 5 days. (https://tracker.redwood/issue/112233)
Noor: Dropping a silly GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/thank-you-team-3o7aD2saalBwwftBIY (adorable penguins)
Aria: Love it. Thanks everyone for the extra hours and the calm heads. We owe you snacks at next all-hands. :confetti_ball:
Ben: snacks accepted. til then, coffee vouchers will do. :grin:
